006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.INodeItem;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.TypeMetapathException;
010
011import java.util.Arrays;
012import java.util.Objects;
013import java.util.stream.Stream;
014
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
017
018/**
019 * Provides a variety of utilities for working with Metapath items.
020 */
021public final class ItemUtils {
022
023  private ItemUtils() {
024    // disable construction
025  }
026
027  /**
028   * Checks that the item is a node item.
029   *
030   * @param item
031   *          the item to check
032   * @return the item cast to a {@link INodeItem}
033   * @throws TypeMetapathException
034   *           if the item is {@code null} or not an {@link INodeItem}
035   */
036  // FIXME: make this a method on the type implementation
037  @NonNull
038  public static INodeItem checkItemIsNodeItemForStep(@Nullable IItem item) {
039    if (item instanceof INodeItem) {
040      return (INodeItem) item;
041    }
042    if (item == null) {
043      throw new TypeMetapathException(TypeMetapathException.NOT_A_NODE_ITEM_FOR_STEP,
044          "Item is null.");
045    }
046    throw new TypeMetapathException(TypeMetapathException.NOT_A_NODE_ITEM_FOR_STEP,
047        String.format(
048            "The item of type '%s' is not a INodeItem.",
049            item.getClass().getName()));
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Check that the item is the type specified by {@code clazz}.
054   *
055   * @param <TYPE>
056   *          the Java type the item is required to match
057   * @param item
058   *          the item to check
059   * @param clazz
060   *          the Java class to check the item against
061   * @return the item cast to the required class value
062   * @throws TypeMetapathException
063   *           if the item is {@code null} or does not match the type specified by
064   *           {@code clazz}
065   */
066  // FIXME: make this a method on the type implementation
067  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
068  @NonNull
069  public static <TYPE> TYPE checkItemType(@NonNull IItem item, @NonNull Class<TYPE> clazz) {
070    if (clazz.isInstance(item)) {
071      return (TYPE) item;
072    }
073    throw new TypeMetapathException(TypeMetapathException.INVALID_TYPE_ERROR,
074        String.format(
075            "The item of type '%s' is not the required type '%s'.",
076            item.getClass().getName(),
077            clazz.getName()));
078  }
079
080  public static <T> Stream<Class<? extends T>> interfacesFor(
081      @NonNull Class<? extends T> seed,
082      @NonNull Class<T> base) {
083    return ancestorsOrSelf(seed)
084        .flatMap(clazz -> Stream.ofNullable(asSubclassOrNull(clazz, base)))
085        .flatMap(clazz -> Stream.concat(
086            Stream.of(clazz),
087            Arrays.stream(seed.getInterfaces())
088                .flatMap(cls -> Stream.ofNullable(asSubclassOrNull(cls, base)))));
089  }
090
091  private static <T> Stream<Class<? super T>> ancestorsOrSelf(@NonNull Class<T> seed) {
092    return Stream.iterate(seed, Objects::nonNull, Class::getSuperclass);
093  }
094
095  @Nullable
096  private static <T> Class<? extends T> asSubclassOrNull(Class<?> clazz, Class<T> base) {
097    Class<? extends T> retval = null;
098    try {
099      retval = clazz.asSubclass(base);
100    } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") ClassCastException ex) {
101      // not a subclass, do nothing
102    }
103    return retval;
104  }
105}
